Package com.nexuslink.ui.files

Class LocalFileSystem

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.ui.files.LocalFileSystem
All Implemented Interfaces:
FileSystem
public final class LocalFileSystem extends Object implements FileSystem
The local disk as a FileSystem, so the same browser pane can show local files next to a remote SFTP/FTP listing (the WinSCP/MobaXterm two-pane layout).

    • exists

      public boolean exists(String dir, String name)
      Description copied from interface: FileSystem
      True if an entry named name already exists in directory dir. Used by the transfer queue to decide whether to raise an overwrite/skip prompt. The default lists dir and matches by name; implementations may override with a cheaper check.
      Specified by:
      exists in interface FileSystem

    • diskSpace

      public Optional<DiskSpace> diskSpace(String path)
      Description copied from interface: FileSystem
      Free/total capacity of the volume backing path, for the pane's status line. Empty by default (remote services that can't report it); LocalFileSystem answers from the disk. Called off the FX thread alongside FileSystem.list(java.lang.String), so an implementation may do blocking I/O.
      Specified by:
      diskSpace in interface FileSystem

    • supportsContentAccess

      public boolean supportsContentAccess()
      Description copied from interface: FileSystem
      True if this file system can read/write whole file contents in memory (for the quick-view / edit-in-place dialog). Object stores and plain local/SFTP/FTP support it; a pane hides the quick-view action when this is false.
      Specified by:

    • checksum

      public String checksum(FileItem item) throws IOException
      Description copied from interface: FileSystem
      The Checksum.ALGORITHM digest of item's content, as hex. The default reads the whole file into memory via FileSystem.readFile(com.nexuslink.ui.files.FileItem, long); an implementation that can stream (or that already knows a digest, e.g. from object-store metadata) should override, along with FileSystem.canChecksum(com.nexuslink.ui.files.FileItem). Callers should consult FileSystem.canChecksum(com.nexuslink.ui.files.FileItem) first — this throws for a file it cannot faithfully hash rather than returning a digest of a truncated read.
      Specified by:
      checksum in interface FileSystem
      Throws:
      IOException

    • supportsCopy

      public boolean supportsCopy()
      Description copied from interface: FileSystem
      True if this file system can duplicate an entry in place (the "Duplicate" action). Defaults to whatever content access allows — a file can be duplicated by reading and re-writing its bytes — so any FS with FileSystem.supportsContentAccess() gets file duplication for free; LocalFileSystem overrides to also copy directory trees.
      Specified by:
      supportsCopy in interface FileSystem

    • copy

      public void copy(FileItem src, String destDir, String destName) throws IOException
      Description copied from interface: FileSystem
